item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 these are three different families inside the same homologous superfamily, not three names for the same family. The alcohol dehydrogenase-like C-terminal domain is family c.2.1.1, SUNID 51736; the CoA-binding domain is family c.2.1.8, SUNID 51900; and the potassium channel NAD-binding domain is family c.2.1.9, SUNID 63944. All three have parent superfamily c.2.1, SUNID 51735, \"NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains\", which is inside fold c.2, SUNID 51734, also named \"NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains\", in class c, \"Alpha and beta proteins (a/b)\". Biologically, SCOPe is asserting probable common ancestry across the three family nodes at the Rossmann NAD(P)-binding-domain level, while keeping them as family-level divergences with different domain contexts and functions: an alcohol-dehydrogenase-like C-terminal Rossmann domain, a CoA-binding Rossmann family, and the NAD-binding regulatory domain found in potassium-channel proteins. Family membership is stronger evidence for close homology and for transferring detailed active-site or ligand-specific features than the cross-family superfamily relationship. The c.2 fold alone should be read only as a shared Rossmann-fold architecture, since SCOPe's homology endpoint explicitly does not imply homology above the superfamily level. Thus a cross-family representative can be useful as a remote structural template for the conserved Rossmann core, but it is unsafe to transfer alcohol dehydrogenase catalysis, CoA-associated specificity, potassium-channel regulation, exact insertions, oligomeric contacts, or precise ligand-binding residues among these families without independent sequence, structural, and biochemical evidence.","evidence_used":["get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/","get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/releases/current","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51734","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51734/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51734/homology"]}]}
